children: Midnight plans to launch private lending in Q4 2026. The service will keep sensitive transaction details private for users on both sides of a loan.

The launch applies Midnight's privacy features to a core financial activity: lending and borrowing. That gives investors evaluating NIGHT for its privacy features a specific use case to consider: users can take part in a loan without making sensitive transaction details public.

💎 Collateral Warehouse - A private global collateral vault where traders can deposit assets once and use them as margin on compatible blockchains without the need for bridging or revealing any public data.

title: Midnight: Private lending launches - Q4 2026
